targets.rawSql: SELECT status, production_manifest_digest, production_input_digest FROM paper_sessions ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT payload FROM paper_equity_curve ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT p.payload AS position, r.payload AS reconciliation FROM paper_positions p LEFT JOIN paper_reconciliation r ON r.session_id=p.session_id ORDER BY p.session_id DESC
